title: Exercise for Fatty Liver Disease
subtitle: Evidence, mechanisms, practical application, progression, and safety considerations for exercise for fatty liver disease
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports exercise as a core therapeutic intervention to reduce hepatic fat and improve metabolic parameters in fatty liver disease. Moderate evidence supports exercise benefits in fibrosis attenuation, while safety data for advanced liver disease patients warrant caution and individualized assessment.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
